description: Installation of a replacement pitched roof, with a roof light and parapet wall, to the existing single storey rear extension, and replacement glazed sliding doors to the main house's ground floor rear elevation and the existing single storey rear extension's side elevation.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (001; 002; 003; 010; 011; 012  Received:  28 March 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the retained and refurbished single storey rear extension hereby approved.
